# Pinned to the exact versions installed in .venv (Python 3.11.9) on 2026-08-11.
# Generated by inspecting the working environment — do not casually bump versions;
# re-validate the whole stack (esp. torch's Blackwell/SM120 kernel support) if you do.
#
# --- PyTorch (GPU, CUDA 12.8 build) -----------------------------------------
# torch is deliberately NOT pinned below with a plain `torch==` line. This
# project needs the CUDA 12.8 (+cu128) build for RTX 50-series/Blackwell
# (SM120) support, which PyPI's default index does not host — a plain
# `torch==2.11.0+cu128` requirement here would make a bare
# `pip install -r requirements.txt` fail outright trying to resolve it.
#
# Install it explicitly, from PyTorch's own CUDA 12.8 index, BEFORE installing
# the rest of this file:
#   pip install torch==2.11.0+cu128 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128
#
# Then install everything else:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Verify afterwards:
#   python -c "import torch; print(torch.__version__, torch.cuda.is_available())"
#   -> should print: 2.11.0+cu128 True
